concerns.text: The plan itself documents that NO verified dataset contains the required schema, so the spec's primary path (US-1 acceptance scenario 1: 'a valid URL to a public dataset containing the required schema') is unsatisfiable. FR-003–FR-008 and SC-001–SC-004 have plan elements only as CONDITIONAL tasks that will never execute; the success criteria are unmeasurable as specified. The plan honestly plans for a halt, but the spec still asserts the analysis will be performed. The spec (root cause) must be revised — either supply a verified dataset with the required variables or formally re-scope the success criteria to the data-availability finding — before the plan's coverage of SC-001..SC-004 can be considered real rather than nominal.
